{"message": "Fixed the `body_frag_len` calculation in `/zephyrproject/zephyr/subsys/net/lib/http/http_client.c`.

### Cause of Defect
In `on_body()`, `req->internal.response.body_frag_len` was calculated as `req->internal.response.data_len - (req->internal.response.body_frag_start - req->internal.response.recv_buf)`. When `Transfer-Encoding: chunked` is used and chunk framing bytes (such as trailing `\r\n0\r\n\r\n`) are present in `recv_buf` after the body data, `data_len` includes those framing bytes, causing `body_frag_len` to overcount the body length.

### Fix
Updated `on_body()` in `subsys/net/lib/http/http_client.c` to accumulate the parsed body length directly (`req->internal.response.body_frag_len += length;`).", "kind": "FinishAction"}
